item.title: A lawsuit seeks to stop Donald Trump’s overhaul of a 100-year-old public golf course in Washington
item.description: Two golfers in Washington, D.C., sued the federal government on Friday to try to prevent the Trump administration from overhauling a more than 100-year-old public golf course.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball survives ugly start to earn 71-56 victory at Marquette
item.description: The UConn women's basketball team overcame an ugly first-half performance to remain unbeaten with a 71-56 win at Marquette on Saturday.

item.title: Four new astronauts arrive at the International Space Station to replace NASA’s evacuated crew
item.description: The International Space Station returned to full strength with Saturday’s arrival of four new astronauts to replace colleagues who bailed early because of health concerns.

item.title: Smith leads Central past Fairleigh Dickinson; New Haven stuns LIU
item.description: Darin Smith Jr.’s 17 points helped Central Connecticut State defeat Fairleigh Dickinson 63-57 in a Northeast Conference game on Saturday at Teaneck, N.J.

item.title: Brutal brawl breaks out, six ejected, in rough-and-tumble matchup between Big East rivals
item.description: Six players were ejected from Saturday’s game between No. 17 St. John's and Providence after a fracas resulting from a hard foul by Friars forward Duncan Powell on Bryce Hopkins sent the Red Storm star crashing to the ground.

item.title: Daily Horoscope for February 15, 2026
item.description: A fresh, wide view could be hard to handle today. With the emotional Moon entering Aquarius at 1:17 am EST, we may feel pulled toward community conversations that spark inventive ideas and build kinder bonds. That said, changing the status quo often requires letting go of dynamics we find comfortable. When Luna conjoins intense Pluto, our feelings about such shifts might burst out in unpleasant ways! There’s more to life than logic, but overwrought emotions are likely to pass if we let them.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball earns No. 1 overall seed in first NCAA Tournament top 16 reveal
item.description: In the first top 16 rankings from the NCAA Tournament selection committee, the UConn women's basketball team is projected No. 1 overall.

item.title: UConn men survive scare from Georgetown, 79-75, as Alex Karaban becomes Huskies’ all-time winner
item.description: The UConn men's basketball team survived a late scare from Georgetown to win, 79-75, on a milestone night at Gampel Pavilion.
